name: Thanh Le-Cong
title: Assistant Professor
university: Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD)
bio: Thanh Le-Cong is a tenure-track Assistant Professor in the Information Systems Technology and Design Pillar (ISTD) at the Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD). He received his PhD in Computing and Information Systems from the University of Melbourne. His research lies at the intersection of software engineering, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity. He develops AI methods to audit software and detect and repair bugs and vulnerabilities, as well as assurance techniques for AI-assisted development and AI-powered systems such as autonomous AI agents. His work appears in top-tier SE and AI venues (e.g., ICSE, FSE, TSE, TOSEM, and ACL), and he received the Google PhD Fellowship in 2023.

news.text: Glad to share that our two papers, led by my undergraduate interns, on vulnerability-affected library identification and LLMs for functional programming are accepted at EMNLP 2026.
Glad to share that our ICSME paper has been awarded TCSE Distinguished Paper Award.
Glad to share that our paper on backdoor defense for Code LLMs is accepted at ICSME 2026.
Glad to share that our emprical study on mining VFCs from NVD is accepted at ACM TOSEM.
Invited to be Chair of Data/AI Models Track of EASE 2027.
Excited to share that I officially joined SUTD.
